review.what: An independent review of T3 (2026-09-30) found: minted identities from 0x40000000 carried musl's MAYBE_WAITERS bit (a minted context would wait for itself in every nested FILE lock; recursive mutexes broken), which the first probes missed because none retook a lock; builds outside capstone_configure_application compiling runtime files one by one without lock.c (the native mapping test failed to build, and an old binary had been run); longjmp reaching the first context's signal state from a further context; a lock depth that could go negative. All fixed; stdio-nested, the Sublet image, spawn-concurrent, mmap-concurrent and nested-create added.
